entries.name: ESEUR
entries.description: All data used in the openly available book Evidence-based Software Engineering

entries.name: FLOSSmole
entries.description: Collaborative collection and analysis of free/libre/open source project data.

entries.name: PROMISE
entries.description: About 20 datasets related to software engineering research.

entries.name: SIR
entries.description: Software-artifact infrastructure repository; Java, C, C++, and C# software together with test suites and fault data.

entries.name: Software Engineering Artifacts Can Really Assist Future Tasks
Zenodo
entries.description: Software data collections in CERN's open-access repository.

entries.name: AndroidTimeMachine
entries.description: Graph-based dataset of commit history of 8,431 real-world Android apps.

entries.name: AndroZoo
entries.description: Collection of Android Applications.

entries.name: Bug Prediction Dataset
entries.description: Collection of models and metrics from Eclipse JDT Core, PDE UI, Equinox Framework, Lucene, Mylyn, and their histories.

entries.name: Code Reviews
entries.description: Code reviews of OpenStack, LibreOffice, AOSP, Qt, Eclipse.

entries.name: CoREBench
entries.description: Collection of 70 realistically Complex Regression Errors that were systematically extracted from the repositories and bug reports of four open-source software projects: Make, Grep, Findutils, and Coreutils.

entries.name: Cryptocurrency GitHub Activity and Market Cap Dataset
entries.description: Activity such as commits, stars, prices, and market cap of over 200 cryptocurrency projects on GitHub over time. Raw, historic data is also available.

entries.name: Defects4J
entries.description: Collection of 395 reproducible bugs collected with the goal of advancing software testing research.

entries.name: Eclipse AERI stacktraces
entries.description: Collection of stacktraces of Exceptions encountered by users of the Eclipse IDE, as retrieved by the AERI reporting system.

entries.name: Enron Spreadsheets and Emails
entries.description: All the spreadsheets and emails used in the paper 'Enron's Spreadsheets and Related Emails: A Dataset and Analysis'.

entries.name: Findbugs-maven
entries.description: Set of FindBugs reports for the Java projects of the Maven repository.

entries.name: GHTorrent
entries.description: Scalable, queriable, offline mirror of data offered through the GitHub REST API.

entries.name: GitHub Bug Dataset
entries.description: Bug Dataset of 15 Java open-source projects characterized by static source code metrics.

entries.name: GitHub on Google BigQuery
entries.description: GitHub data accessible through Google's BigQuery platform.

entries.name: Grammar Zoo
entries.description: Collection of grammars of DSLs and GPLs, some extracted from metamodels and document schemata.

entries.name: KaVE
entries.description: Developer tool interaction data.

entries.name: Linux Kernel 4.21 Call Graphs
entries.description: The Linux Kernel 4.21 Call Graphs produced using CScout.

entries.name: Maven metrics
entries.description: Collection of software complexity & sizing metrics for the Maven Repository.

entries.name: Maven Dependency Graph
entries.description: Snapshot of the whole Maven Central taken on September 6, 2018, stored in a graph database.

entries.name: mzdata
entries.description: Multi-extract and multi-level dataset of Mozilla issue tracking history.

entries.name: npm-miner
entries.description: The dataset contains the analysis results of 5 open source software quality tools eslint, escomplex, nsp, jsinspect and sonarjs for 2000 popular (in terms of stars and downloads) npm packages.

entries.name: OCL Expressions on GitHub
entries.description: Data set of 9188 OCL expressions originating from 504 EMF meta-models in 245 systematically selected GitHub repositories.

entries.name: RepoReapers Data Set
entries.description: Data set containing a collection of engineered software projects from GHTorrent.

entries.name: Software Heritage Graph Dataset
entries.description: Graph of the development history and file metadata of >80 million software projects from various forges (GitHub, Gitlab, Debian, PyPI, Google Code, etc) in a deduplicated and unified representation (paper here).

entries.name: STAMINA
entries.description: (STAte Machine INference Approaches) data are used to benchmark techniques for learning deterministic finite state machines (FSMs).

entries.name: Stack Exchange
entries.description: Anonymized dump of all user-contributed content on the Stack Exchange network.

entries.name: SWE-bench
entries.description: SWE-bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of AI models to solve real-world software engineering problems by generating fixes for issues found in open-source code repositories.

entries.name: TravisTorrent
entries.description: Provides free and easy-to-use Traivs CI build analyses.

entries.name: Ultimate Debian Database (UDD)
entries.description: Data about various aspects of Debian (e.g. packages, bugs, mainteners) in the same SQL database.

entries.name: Unified Bug Dataset
entries.description: Static source code based datasets which includes the Bugcatchers Bug Dataset, the Bug Prediction Dataset, the Eclipse Bug Dataset, the GitHub Bug Dataset, some datasets from the PROMISE repository.

entries.name: Unix history
entries.description: Git repository with 46 years of Unix history evolution.

entries.name: astminer
entries.description: Library and tool for mining of path-based representations of code and other data derived from ASTs.

entries.name: Boa
entries.description: Domain-specific language and infrastructure that eases mining software repositories.

entries.name: buckwheat
entries.description: Multi-language tokenizer for extracting identifiers from source code.

entries.name: ckjm
entries.description: Chidamber and Kemerer Java Metrics.

entries.name: Coming
entries.description: A Java framework for analyzing code changes and mining instances of change patterns from Git repositories.

entries.name: CryptOSS
entries.description: Mine GitHub activity and market cap data for cryptocurrency projects.

entries.name: DbDeo
entries.description: Extract embedded SQL statements and detect database schema smells.

entries.name: DesigniteJava
entries.description: Compute source code metrics and detect a variety of implementation and design smells for Java.

entries.name: Diggit
entries.description: Agile Ruby Tool to analyze Git repositories.

entries.name: GitEvo
entries.description: Code evolution analysis for Git repositories.

entries.name: GrimoireLab

entries.name: Maven-miner

entries.name: Perceval
entries.description: Fetch repository data from tens of back-ends.

entries.name: Puppeteer
entries.description: Detect configuration smells in Puppet code.

entries.name: PyDriller
entries.description: Python Framework to analyse Git repositories.

entries.name: qmcalc
entries.description: Calculate quality metrics from C source code.

entries.name: reaper
entries.description: Python tool to compute a score for a repository from GHTorrent. The score quantifies the extent to which the project contained within the repository is engineered.

entries.name: RefactoringMiner
entries.description: Library/API for detection of refactorings in changes of Java code.

entries.name: TestMiner
entries.description: Software testing analysis for GitHub repositories.

entries.name: VulData7
entries.description: Java framework enabling the automated collection of commits fixing vulnerabilities that are reported in NVD (links NVD with Git).
